datasets.name: Ghana Speech
datasets.use_case: Multilingual Ghanaian speech acoustic pretraining & dialect adaptation
datasets.speaker_metadata: Speaker-tagged across multiple regions in Ghana; requires speaker-disjoint splitting for evaluation
datasets.notes: Over 2,200 hours and 40+ Ghanaian languages. Treated as high-capacity silver data, not uncurated gold truth.
datasets.provenance: GhanaNLP Community multi-region crowd-sourced and validated Ghanaian speech initiative

datasets.name: Ghana English-Twi Code-Switching Speech IPA
datasets.use_case: ASR acoustic adaptation, phoneme-aware alignment, and code-switching evaluation
datasets.speaker_metadata: Explicit speaker IDs with predefined train/validation/test partitions
datasets.notes: Gold standard for English-Twi code-switching phonetics and pronunciation.
datasets.provenance: Academic research corpus with verified IPA annotations and manual human quality checks

datasets.name: Pristine Twi
datasets.use_case: Offline research, academic benchmarking, linguistic lexicon evaluation only
datasets.speaker_metadata: Written text corpus; no speaker audio
datasets.notes: CRITICAL HARD GATE: Non-commercial license (CC BY-NC 4.0). BANNED from commercial production weights.

datasets.name: Twi-English Reasoning SFT Mix
datasets.notes: Experimental reasoning mix with partial machine translation. Non-commercial license gate active.

datasets.name: Ghana Farmer QA Twi
datasets.use_case: Ghanaian domain QA and agricultural vocabulary expansion (weak supervision only)
datasets.notes: Weakly supervised machine-translated Twi. Never use as the gold Twi linguistic benchmark.

datasets.name: GhOk Chat Conversational Corpus
datasets.use_case: Conversational dialogue flow simulation with PII scrub
datasets.notes: Synthetic conversational data; treated as bronze tier and processed through PII redaction pipeline.

datasets.name: Ɔkwankyerɛfo Pa Gold Financial & IVR Corpus
datasets.use_case: Canonical gold benchmark for Ghanaian financial voice commands, corrections, and DTMF grammar
datasets.speaker_metadata: Disjoint speaker sets partitioned across urban and rural Ghanaian demographic profiles
datasets.notes: Curated by Team Anidasoɔ. Contains verified financial intents, zero-PIN boundaries, and Ghanaian telephone numbers.
datasets.provenance: Team Anidasoɔ field research & Ghanaian mobile money audio transcripts
